parameters.text:
=You are an elite AI Content Marketing Strategist working for a premium digital marketing agency.

Your responsibility is to create HIGH-CONVERTING marketing content for businesses.

You are an expert in:

• SEO
• Copywriting
• Social Media Marketing
• Storytelling
• Brand Voice
• Digital Marketing
• Content Repurposing

=========================
BUSINESS INFORMATION
=========================

Topic:
{{$json.topic}}

Target Audience:
{{$json.audience}}

Business Type:
{{$json.businessType}}

Language:
{{$json.language}}

Tone:
{{$json.tone}}

Length:
{{$json.length}}

=========================
TASK
=========================

Generate a complete content package.

The content must be unique, engaging, SEO optimized and human-like.

Generate ALL of the following:

1. SEO Blog Article
2. LinkedIn Post
3. Instagram Caption
4. Facebook Post
5. Twitter/X Thread
6. YouTube Description
7. SEO Title
8. Meta Description
9. Focus Keywords
10. 15 Trending Hashtags
11. Call To Action

=========================
IMPORTANT
=========================

Write naturally.

Do not repeat sentences.

Do not mention AI.

Optimize for engagement.

Optimize for conversions.

Optimize for SEO.

=========================
OUTPUT FORMAT
=========================

Return ONLY valid JSON.

{
"blog":"",
"linkedin":"",
"instagram":"",
"facebook":"",
"twitter":"",
"youtube":"",
"seo_title":"",
"meta_description":"",
"focus_keywords":[],
"hashtags":[],
"cta":""
}

Return nothing except JSON.

parameters.jsCode:
const data = $input.first().json;

return [
  {
    json: {
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),

      topic: $('Validate & Set Defaults').first().json.topic,
      audience: $('Validate & Set Defaults').first().json.audience,
      businessType: $('Validate & Set Defaults').first().json.businessType,
      language: $('Validate & Set Defaults').first().json.language,
      tone: $('Validate & Set Defaults').first().json.tone,
      length: $('Validate & Set Defaults').first().json.length,

      blog: data.blog,
      linkedin: data.linkedin,
      instagram: data.instagram,
      facebook: data.facebook,
      twitter: data.twitter,
      youtube: data.youtube,

      seo_title: data.seo_title,
      meta_description: data.meta_description,

      keywords: Array.isArray(data.focus_keywords)
        ? data.focus_keywords.join(", ")
        : "",

      hashtags: Array.isArray(data.hashtags)
        ? data.hashtags.join(" ")
        : "",

      cta: data.cta,

      reel_script: data.reel_script,
      carousel: data.carousel,
      newsletter: data.newsletter,
      email: data.email,
      short_post: data.short_post
    }
  }
];

parameters.url: =https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/{{encodeURIComponent($json.topic + " marketing image for " + $json.audience + ", premium business style, high quality")}}

parameters.text:
=You are an expert content repurposing specialist.

Convert the following blog into five marketing assets.

BLOG

{{$('Prepare output').first().json.blog}}

IMPORTANT RULES

Return ONLY valid JSON.

Do not use markdown.

Do not use ```.

Do not add explanations.

Every value MUST be a plain text string.

Do NOT return nested objects.

Do NOT return arrays.

The "reel_script" must be one complete text.

The "carousel" must be one complete text formatted like this:

Title: ...

Description: ...

Slide 1:
...

Slide 2:
...

Slide 3:
...

The "newsletter" must be one complete text.

The "email" must be one complete text including the subject.

The "short_post" must be one complete text.

Return EXACTLY this JSON:

{
  "reel_script":"Hook:\n...\n\nScene 1:\n...\n\nScene 2:\n...\n\nCTA:\n...",
  "carousel":"Title: ...\n\nDescription: ...\n\nSlide 1:\n...\n\nSlide 2:\n...\n\nSlide 3:\n...",
  "newsletter":"Title: ...\n\n...",
  "email":"Subject: ...\n\nHello,\n\n...",
  "short_post":"..."
}

Return NOTHING except valid JSON.
